description: Ask Gemma, the Hey Anon crypto research assistant: protocol analysis, community and social insights, market data, news, token analytics by contract address. Synchronous: returns the answer text directly, no polling and no wallet addresses needed. Research only: Gemma takes no wallet addresses, executes no transactions and keeps its own session, separate from the Anon conversation. Prefer ask_gemma for general crypto questions and ask_anon for anything about the user wallets or for actions.
